sourcePlan.task.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourcePlan.task.scenario: 2乘2网格删去一个角部单元区域，两层3.6m，全部实际梁柱按表给出；完整属性按公共契约随题给出。 基本网格X=0/6/12m、Y=0/5/10m；右上角格区缺失，实际构件表为准，各存留梁8kN/m。
sourcePlan.task.modelingFocus: 不能补齐缺失角区与虚构楼面
sourcePlan.task.expectedOutput: 两层外角/内凹角节点三向位移、实际柱列层间位移差、各柱脚反力。
sourcePlan.task.gradingFocus: 不能补齐缺失角区与虚构楼面；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourcePlan.task.prerequisite: 不规则楼面荷载映射需验证；完整题面、参数/单位契约与真值待验证
sourcePlan.model.topologyKey: 空间两层L形平面；右上角格区不存在
sourcePlan.model.boundaryKey: 全部实际柱脚六自由度固定
sourcePlan.model.loadKey: 仅全部实际梁同值直接线载
sourcePlan.model.propertyKey: 单钢材料；梁柱分组截面及局部轴
sourcePlan.engine.analysisContract: 保留题定几何、材料截面、边界、全部目标输出及一阶线弹性静力；自重关闭，不新增刚性楼板、刚域或默认组合。梁线载/单向受荷宽度严格按题，禁止自动双向传载或面线载叠加；原生 DL/LL、坐标轴、单位、工况/组合须有显式对应。
sourcePlan.engine.executionRequirement: 拟要求真实 PKPM 原生建模和求解，并交付关联本题的项目、计算日志及原始结果；OpenSees 替代或仅生成兼容文件不能计作原生计算完成。
sourcePlan.engine.requiredEvidence: 拟保存（尚未生成）：PKPM 版本、独立模型/项目标识、节点构件属性及荷载审计表、原生计算日志、原始结果文件；位移/端力/反力逐项关联模型、构件、工况与单位。
sourcePlan.engine.adapterGap: 重复楼层模板内的 L 形节点/连接表须逐项验收；仅楼面 DL/LL 的入口需补本题实际梁 8 kN/m 加载映射，结果读取器缺各柱脚节点反力。另须验收自重关闭、无刚性楼板、轴系/单位及题定工况到原生设置的映射；未实际运行。
sourcePlan.engine.truthPlan: 拟在 PKPM 中独立建模并人工审定输入、版本和分析设置，生成本题全部要求的位移/内力/反力同引擎标答；审查缺角实际连接图、刚度秩和真实受载梁，再以独立杆系解与空间平衡复核。旧值仅作线索，不直接继承；跨引擎仅校核，不以 OpenSees 唯一判卷。尚未生成。

turns.instruction:
Required solver: PKPM.
Use PKPM native analysis for a two-story L-plan steel frame. Start from grid X=0/6/12 m and Y=0/5/10 m; remove the northeast cell region at both floors. The actual member table is authoritative: the line at X=12 m stops at Y=5 m and the line at Y=10 m stops at X=6 m; the re-entrant corner (6,5) remains. Story heights are 3.6+3.6 m. All eight existing bases are fixed in six DOFs. Apply 8 kN/m downward to each existing floor beam only. Analyze D and report three translations at every outer and re-entrant floor corner, X/Y story differences along every existing column line, and all base-reaction components.

Use all public appendices. Report the complete requested numerical table and the required summaries.

authoringNotes: The source leaves the property appendix to the author. Frozen sections: X beams B1 solid rectangle 300x600 mm, Y beams B2 solid rectangle 300x700 mm, columns C1 solid square 500x500 mm. E/G, A/Iy/Iz/J and local reference vectors are explicit in public input; no section catalog or solver defaults apply.
All story drift requests are signed upper-node displacement minus lower-node displacement, for every existing column line. No diaphragm average replaces column-line results.
Broad source terms such as representative beam/column end forces are resolved by requesting all relevant members, rather than omitting an unspecified representative location.

The northeast cell is absent: omit only the corner column line (12,10) and its incident edge beams; retain the re-entrant corner (6,5) and boundary beams of the remaining three cells. No duplicate nodes or phantom fourth-cell elements.
